answer: A key votes only with hollow, and every key's hollow halves each epoch. Restoring it to 100 hollow means burning marble. Atlas auditors trace funding between keys and link keys that share a source to one operator. That operator's k-th linked key burns 10·k marble per restore. An honest newcomer keeps full weight for 10 marble an epoch. An operator holding 100 clones burns 50,500 marble every epoch for as long as it wants them to vote, because hollow cannot be stored or pooled across keys.
